# HELP cs_machines Machines by state.
# TYPE cs_machines gauge
cs_machines{state="running"} 2
cs_machines{state="we\"ird\\\n"} 1
# HELP cs_queue_length Waiting tasks.
# TYPE cs_queue_length gauge
cs_queue_length 2
# HELP cs_requests_total Requests by path.
# TYPE cs_requests_total counter
cs_requests_total{path="/v1/acquire",code="200"} 3
cs_requests_total{path="/v1/status",code="401"} 1
# HELP cs_unused Never set.
# TYPE cs_unused gauge
# HELP cs_wait_seconds Wait time.\nSecond line with \\ backslash.
# TYPE cs_wait_seconds histogram
cs_wait_seconds_bucket{le="0.5"} 1
cs_wait_seconds_bucket{le="1"} 3
cs_wait_seconds_bucket{le="5"} 4
cs_wait_seconds_bucket{le="+Inf"} 5
cs_wait_seconds_sum 104.6
cs_wait_seconds_count 5
